;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021)]]
**[[United States Secretary of Defense|U.S. Defense Secretary]] [[Mark Esper]] says [[United States|American]] troops withdrawing from [[Syria]] will go to western [[Iraq]], where the [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] will continue to conduct operations against the [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]] to prevent its resurgence. [https://news.yahoo.com/defense-chief-us-troops-leaving-053046547.html (Yahoo! News)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Second inauguration of Joko Widodo]]
**[[Joko Widodo]] is officially inaugurated as [[president of Indonesia]] for the second time, while [[Ma'ruf Amin]] is inaugurated as the new [[Vice President of Indonesia|vice president]]. They will serve their terms from 2019 to 2024. [https://en.tempo.co/read/1262063/jokowi-maruf-officially-named-president-vp-period-of-2019-2024 (''Tempo'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/indonesia-president-joko-widodo-sworn-final-term-191020052716823.html?fbclid=IwAR0PFoVkwRGtN7ry8XqvpFVV1erH4SfY-ZItTjzw-53o6UwFNZrXTBWb3lA (Al Jazeera)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Bolivian general election]]
**People in [[Bolivia]] head to the polls for the latest [[general election]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/20191020-bolivia-goes-to-polls-as-left-wing-icon-evo-morales-seeks-unprecedented-fourth-term-1?fbclid=IwAR09Q5hONdZkcFocQS5ZqRW6phvH4v0ZzuGGj94bVFGwXXPnwk28QTOPNEU (France 24)]
**Authorities abruptly stop updating the results, causing concern among opposition politicians and the [[Organization of American States]], which has election observers in [[Bolivia]]. Before the results were halted, incumbent [[President of Bolivia|President]] [[Evo Morales]] held 45 percent of the vote and former [[President of Bolivia|President]] [[Carlos Mesa]] held 38 percent. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-50119655 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 Santiago protests|2019 Chilean protests]]
**Curfew is extended to [[Concepción Province, Chile|Concepción]] and [[Valparaíso Region]]. Including [[Santiago, Chile|Santiago]], nine million people are under a [[state of emergency]], equal to 52 percent of the country's population. [https://www.latercera.com/nacional/noticia/ministro-chadwick-anuncia-se-decretara-toque-queda-tambien-concepcion/869631/ (''La Tercera'')] [https://sputniknews.com/latam/201910201077097640-chilean-authorities-impose-curfews-in-several-provinces-amid-mass-protests---reports/?fbclid=IwAR37oLxFTAlx_v8QRPWXyQrD5ylmTWy_M6TsM3zsDmUJonFIWhfUngB8Pdg (Sputnik)]
**Three people are found dead in a supermarket that had been set on fire in [[San Bernardo, Chile|San Bernardo]]. [https://www.biobiochile.cl/noticias/nacional/region-metropolitana/2019/10/20/confirman-tres-muertos-en-incendio-de-supermercado-en-san-bernardo.shtml (BioBioChile)] [https://www.rawstory.com/2019/10/three-dead-in-chile-protest-violence/?fbclid=IwAR1CnIIs8AUd2vXRlrk2xLTrFVsAnNQBiZraZw2QJPy4AumiuetAhEE9en0 (The Raw Story)]
*[[2019 Swiss federal election]]
**Voters in [[Switzerland]] elect the members of the country's [[Federal Assembly (Switzerland)|Federal Assembly]] and [[Federal Council (Switzerland)|Council]]. Provisional results show the [[Swiss People's Party]] retaining their plurality, and that the [[Green Party of Switzerland|Green Party]] has become the fourth-largest party. [https://www.dw.com/en/green-gains-expected-as-swiss-voters-head-to-the-polls/a-50903915 (DW)] [https://lenews.ch/2019/10/20/swiss-federal-election-results-2019-winners-and-losers/ (''Le News'')] [https://www.thelocal.ch/20191020/swiss-vote-in-possible-green-wave-election?fbclid=IwAR0tmVDR17mhGYz0hiWJ7VGp1d9wi2TLrkmA4u5n8M42KA6SW1t_SNj9oT4 (''The Local'')]
*[[Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh]]
**The government of [[Bangladesh]] announces it will begin moving thousands of [[Rohingya people|Rohingya]] refugees from crowded camps to the flood-prone island of [[Thengar Char]], starting early November. The government hopes to relocate 100,000 refugees by the end of the operation, which has been criticised by rights groups as an "inevitable" humanitarian crisis. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/bangladesh-thousands-rohingya-agree-relocation-island-191020074723514.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rohingya-bangladesh/bangladesh-to-move-rohingya-to-flood-prone-island-next-month-idUSKBN1WZ0DR (Reuters)]
